narratives.Description: Contextual guardrails (PowerShell encoding, SCM-boundary, safe-subprocess, cascade automation, platform-conditional rules) should not occupy always-on paragraph bulk. Per DD-2 and #2157 precedent, move them behind runtime-detect lazy doc pointers.

Do not rework universal one-liners already relocated by #2453.
narratives.UserStory: As a framework maintainer, I want contextual guardrails loaded only when the runtime matches, so that always-on AGENTS.md stops carrying platform-specific rule bulk.

Given agents_entry_contract and verify:eval-health-relocation, when run on the PR diff, then both pass.
